scenarios.title: A｜计划活动
scenarios.setting: 在“纪念日与关系日常”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“计划活动”。

turns.text: Our anniversary is coming up next weekend.

turns.prompt: 你想提议一起安排纪念日活动，会怎么说？

choices.text: I know! Do you want to do something special?

feedback.naturalExpression: I know! Do you want to do something special?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

choices.text: Yeah, I’ve been thinking about what we could do.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’ve been thinking about what we could do.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: Should we go somewhere for the weekend?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should we go somewhere for the weekend?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: How about going back to the restaurant from our first date?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about going back to the restaurant from our first date?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: What should we do in our anniversary?

feedback.naturalExpression: I know! Do you want to do something special?
feedback.explanation: 纪念日的安排通常用“for our anniversary”；问“What should we do for our anniversary?”即可。

turns.text: Going back to that restaurant would be cute.

turns.prompt: 你想提出预订或预约需求，会怎么说？

choices.text: I thought so too. I can make a reservation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I thought so too. I can make a reservation.
feedback.explanation: “reservation”指预订，指已经或准备安排的预约记录。

choices.text: We could have dinner there and do something afterward.

feedback.naturalExpression: We could have dinner there and do something afterward.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Do you want to keep it simple, or make a whole day of it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you want to keep it simple, or make a whole day of it?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

turns.text: Let’s keep it simple. Dinner and maybe a walk afterward?

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: That sounds perfect to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: That sounds perfect to me.
feedback.explanation: “that sounds perfect”积极回应刚听到的建议，表示愿意接受或有兴趣参与。

choices.text: Yeah, I’d rather do something relaxed too.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I’d rather do something relaxed too.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: Great. I’ll book us a table.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. I’ll book us a table.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜准备礼物
scenarios.setting: 在“纪念日与关系日常”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“准备礼物”。

turns.text: I’ve been thinking about what to get you for our anniversary.
You don’t have to get me anything!

turns.prompt: 你想表达仍想准备一点心意，会怎么说？

choices.text: I know, but I’d still like to get you something small.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know, but I’d still like to get you something small.
feedback.explanation: “still”强调原来的状态目前没有改变，是跟进进度或确认安排时的关键信息。

choices.text: Don’t worry, I’m not planning anything expensive.

feedback.naturalExpression: Don’t worry, I’m not planning anything expensive.
feedback.explanation: 用简短回应表示不介意或愿意体谅，可以减轻对方的歉意。

choices.text: I just want to give you something meaningful.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just want to give you something meaningful.
feedback.explanation: “I just want”强调自己真正希望解决的事，能把讨论拉回具体诉求。

choices.text: Is there anything you’ve been wanting lately?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything you’ve been wanting lately?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Tell me what gift you want me to buy you.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I know, but I’d still like to get you something small.
feedback.explanation: 直接让对方报出要买的礼物有下单感；问有没有特别想要的东西，更能表达关心和商量。

turns.text: Honestly, I’d rather do something together than get a big gift.

turns.prompt: 关于「纪念日与关系日常」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: I like that idea. Maybe we could plan a day trip instead.

feedback.naturalExpression: I like that idea. Maybe we could plan a day trip instead.
feedback.explanation: “I like”直接分享喜好，后面说出具体类别，能给对方继续聊的话题。

choices.text: That actually sounds better. We could spend the day somewhere together.

feedback.naturalExpression: That actually sounds better. We could spend the day somewhere together.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: Okay, no big gifts. Maybe I’ll still surprise you with something small.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, no big gifts. Maybe I’ll still surprise you with something small.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

turns.text: Something small is fine. Now I’m curious, though.

turns.prompt: 你想轻松回应对方对礼物的好奇，会怎么说？

choices.text: You’ll have to wait and see.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’ll have to wait and see.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: I’m definitely not telling you now. That would ruin the surprise.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m definitely not telling you now. That would ruin the surprise.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

scenarios.title: C｜忘记纪念日
scenarios.setting: 玩家突然意识到自己忘记了两人的纪念日。

turns.text: Do you know what day it is today?

turns.prompt: 你想意识到自己忘了纪念日，并作出回应，会怎么说？

choices.text: Oh no… I forgot our anniversary, didn’t I?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh no… I forgot our anniversary, didn’t I?
feedback.explanation: “anniversary”指周年纪念日，可用于婚恋或其他重要事件。

choices.text: Wait—it’s our anniversary. I’m so sorry.

feedback.naturalExpression: Wait—it’s our anniversary. I’m so sorry.
feedback.explanation: “anniversary”指周年纪念日，可用于婚恋或其他重要事件。

choices.text: I just realized what day it is. I can’t believe I forgot.

feedback.naturalExpression: I just realized what day it is. I can’t believe I forgot.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I’m really sorry. I completely lost track of the date.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m really sorry. I completely lost track of the date.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Why didn’t you remind me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh no… I forgot our anniversary, didn’t I?
feedback.explanation: 这句语法没问题，但在自己忘记纪念日后反问对方，容易把责任推回去；先承认疏忽更能回应对方的失落。

turns.prompt: 你想为刚才的情况致歉或作些说明，会怎么说？

choices.text: I should have remembered. I’m really sorry.

feedback.naturalExpression: I should have remembered. I’m really sorry.
feedback.explanation: “should have”谈过去时可表示本该这样做，适合反思或承认疏忽。

choices.text: You’re right to be upset. I messed up.

feedback.naturalExpression: You’re right to be upset. I messed up.
feedback.explanation: “messed up”承认自己把事情搞砸了，是承担过错的口语说法。

choices.text: I don’t have a good excuse. I genuinely forgot, and I’m sorry.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t have a good excuse. I genuinely forgot, and I’m sorry.
feedback.explanation: “I’m sorry”先表达歉意或遗憾，再说明具体情况，能照顾对方的感受。

choices.text: I know saying sorry doesn’t fix it, but I do want to make it up to you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I know saying sorry doesn’t fix it, but I do want to make it up to you.
feedback.explanation: “up to”谈限额时表示最多达到某个数量，适合确认包含的额度。

turns.text: I’m not angry about the gift or anything. I’m just hurt that you forgot.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. It’s not about the gift—it’s about remembering something important to us.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. It’s not about the gift—it’s about remembering something important to us.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: Yeah, I get why that hurt you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah, I get why that hurt you.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I’m sorry I made you feel like it wasn’t important to me. It is.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry I made you feel like it wasn’t important to me. It is.
feedback.explanation: “I’m sorry”先表达歉意或遗憾，再说明具体情况，能照顾对方的感受。

choices.text: Can I make it up to you? Maybe we could do something together this weekend.

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I make it up to you? Maybe we could do something together this weekend.
feedback.explanation: “up to”谈限额时表示最多达到某个数量，适合确认包含的额度。

turns.prompt: 关于「纪念日与关系日常」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Then I’ll plan something for us. And this time, I’m putting the date in my calendar.

feedback.naturalExpression: Then I’ll plan something for us. And this time, I’m putting the date in my calendar.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thank you. I promise I’ll do better next time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I promise I’ll do better next time.
feedback.explanation: “next time”把可能的参与留到下次，适合婉拒当下的邀请。
